error: Unsupported n64.plain.O3 after zero-initialized catalog construction
cause: The code, type, function, memory and export sections are identical. Binaryen removed the all-zero data and its data-count section from the catalog. The key incorrectly retained section 12 while ignoring section 11.
fix: Exclude data-count as well, after validating active segments and matching catalog code that contains no memory.init/data.drop.
